payload.reason: The evidence provides a comparison of the model's performance against baseline methods in terms of efficiency and effectiveness in the recipe retrieval task.

claims.text: The proposed model performs similarly to the baseline implementation of BIBREF17 in the recipe retrieval task.
The model significantly reduces training time compared to baseline methods, completing training in under 30 hours versus six days for some baselines.
The model offers more flexibility for dataset alterations compared to baseline methods that require extensive preprocessing.
